criteria.requirement: The 2nd call is open to young people from the 90 States and governments of the OIF (members, associates, observers); the OIF's own list of its 53 member states names Congo (RD).
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

criteria.quote: L'appel est ouvert aux jeunes de 18 à 34 ans issus des 90 États et gouvernements de l'OIF

criteria.requirement: An innovative entrepreneurial project; in the 1st call it had to be at advanced ideation stage at minimum. No registered business is mentioned.
criteria.applicant: No registered business recorded; no project recorded.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant has an innovative entrepreneurial project at advanced-ideation stage (the profile records no business or project).
criteria.quote: Les projets doivent être en phase d'idéation avancée au minimum

criteria.requirement: No degree or study requirement is stated on the pages read.
No work-experience requirement is stated on the pages read.

funding.conditions: Seed prize for each of the 8 grand laureates only (two per category), chosen by the jury among the 20 supported projects; not given to every participant.
funding.quote: recevra un prix d'amorçage de 10 000 euros pour développer son initiative, en complément d'une année de soutien sur mesure incluant mentorat et mise en réseau

funding.conditions: The 100 selected laureates follow a structured support path with thematic training modules in September 2026; the pages do not say who pays for it or whether it is free, and mention no fee.
funding.quote: bénéficiera d'un parcours structuré d'accompagnement durant le mois de septembre 2026

out_of_pocket: Unknown: no application fee is mentioned on the pages read, and the cost or format of the training month is not stated.

cycles.quote: Vous avez jusqu'au 21 mai 2025 pour déposer votre candidature via la plateforme officielle
La date limite pour l'envoi des candidatures est fixée au 10 mai 2026
